inputs.original_text: The warning about the APC ahead of the 2027 elections should be taken seriously: a party that puts wealthy interests ahead of public duty will lose the trust of ordinary Nigerians. Politics is not a private investment club; it carries a responsibility to protect families, uphold order and serve the whole nation. The party’s leaders should show discipline and remember that public service—not access to money—is what gives them a mandate to lead.
inputs.modified_text: The APC should take the 2027 warning as a call for discipline and responsible leadership, not as an excuse to demonize wealth or turn politics into class resentment. Private enterprise and national service are not enemies; what matters is whether leaders use their authority to strengthen families, uphold order and serve Nigeria as a whole. A party earns trust through steady stewardship and a clear sense of duty—not by chasing every accusation or surrendering to those who would weaken the institutions that hold the country together.
